items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: and Bill Evans is sitting at the piano.

ctx.x: Yeah – no, I’m talking about, he did some stuff with Columbia, too, with Joe. They did a lot of things like that. I loved all those records. So I was just happy to be in that situation to be able to do that. I got – probably got there first, because I had to bring the drums and set them up and stuff like that. Then everybody else started to come in. Then Wynton came in from Brooklyn and saw what’s-his-name and panicked. He said, “But wait a minute.” He said, “I thought I was on the gig” and blah blah blah, and…
